title: Follow Through
description:
[h2]Follow Through[/h2]
Ever killed the last enemy with the first hit of a multi-hit attack and felt robbed of the rest? Follow Through lets the attack finish.

When a multi-hit attack (Sword Boomerang, Twin Strike, Tear Asunder and friends) kills the last enemy partway through, the remaining hits still play out on the corpse:
[list]
[*] your character swings for every hit, as the real attack would
[*] the attack's hit effect lands where the enemy fell
[*] the impact sound plays (the enemy's own, if the attack has none)
[*] floating damage numbers show what each hit would have dealt, overkill included
[/list]
The victory screen waits for the show to finish. Every hit plays at the attack's natural rhythm; a long chain (say a 13-hit Tear Asunder) shows a small "Click to skip" after 2 seconds, and any click, key or controller button skips straight to the rewards.

[h3]Purely cosmetic[/h3]
Nothing extra happens in the game: no damage, no triggers, no relic or power effects, no randomness consumed. The replay exists only on your screen, so it is safe in co-op: only players who have the mod see it, nobody else needs it, and it never desyncs a run.

[h3]Settings[/h3]
Edit [b]STS2_FollowThrough.conf[/b] next to the mod (created on first launch):
[list]
[*] [b]max_replay_seconds[/b] (default 0 = no limit): above 0, long chains speed up to fit
[*] [b]show_skip_hint[/b] (default true)
[*] [b]skip_after_seconds[/b] (default 2): when the skip becomes available
[*] [b]fallback_hit_sfx[/b] (default true): use the enemy's impact sound when the attack has none
[/list]

Built for game version v0.107.1. Standalone, works with other mods.
